fact: The driver of Car 11 drove his car across the track into the path of oncoming cars.
offence: Breach of Appendix L, Chapter IV, Article 2 e) of the International Sporting Code.
reason: The Stewards reviewed positioning/marshalling system data, telemetry and video evidence. Car 11 spun and stopped sideways on the right hand side of the track. The driver then appeared to drive directly across the track at right angles to the oncoming traffic. However the evidence tabled showed that the driver attempted to do a rapid 90 degree clockwise spin but in doing so, experienced clutch failure which resulted in the car travelling across the track. Whilst this appeared potentially dangerous from the video, the attempted move by the driver was possible to execute under normal circumstances and only the failure of the clutch caused the reported incident.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Decision Car 11 Alleged Dangerous Driving
to: The Team Manager, Oracle Red Bull Racing
